question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

The judge will **pass** the verdict.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Announce)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Announce"** means to make something known publicly or officially, often through a declaration. (घोषणा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The principal will announce the results tomorrow during the assembly.
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, "The judge will pass the verdict," the correct synonym or homonym is "announce," as a judge declares or announces the final decision in a case. (घोषणा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The judge will announce his decision after reviewing the evidence presented in court.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Announce)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cross** (क्रॉस): To move across or intersect something, or to oppose.

 
 
• **Example:** The players had to cross the river to reach the finish line.
 
 
 
• **Fail** (विफल): To be unsuccessful in achieving a goal or outcome.
 
 
• **Example:** If you don’t study, you might fail the exam.
 
 
 
• **Shift** (स्थानांतरित करना): To move or change position.
 
 
• **Example:** The workers will shift the boxes to the storage room.
